title: Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure
description:
[SRU] Backport FIPS 140 checksum fix to Stonking

This backports the dh_strip_nondeterminism exclusion for the FIPS module ZIP files to the Stonking release.

The detailed SRU impact, and test plan are in the linked bug.

Original approved MP for sponsor context: https://code.launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/ubuntu/+source/golang-1.27/+git/golang-1.27/+merge/514448

PPA Build: https://launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/+archive/ubuntu/fips-fix/+packages?field.name_filter=golang-1.27&field.status_filter=published&field.series_filter=stonking
commit_message:
Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure

LP: #2174696
